label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

Windows files use CRLF line endings, so lines extracted via split('\n') retain a trailing carriage return (\r) on each line. This causes fields on data rows to include \r on the last column, making fields.length !== header.length and triggering row shape errors.
